subject: Renewal discussion — add APAC region, EU residency controls, and cross-region failover SOW
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthlycare.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Cheng <olivia.cheng@dataverse.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & regional expansion — APAC + EU residency questions

Avery,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting our renewal prep and want to add two items to scope:

1) APAC region for production traffic (initial pilot in sin/hkg) — estimate + timeline for capacity increase (we expect a 2x token growth during business hours).
2) EU data residency lock for EU customer traffic with failover to APAC in DR scenario — we need an editable addendum for legal to sign that lays out residency guarantees, cross-region failover behavior, and logging/audit controls.

Additional asks: can you confirm whether the prefix caching and autoscaling settings will remain identical across dedicated pools? We’d like to avoid surprises on latency. Also, please share a SOW with staged deliverables and cost delta vs current committed capacity.

If helpful, Olivia from Dataverse (our integration partner) is looped for technical ops details. Can we get a plan + rough numbers this week? Renewal target: May 1.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Operations
HealthlyCare

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthlycare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & regional expansion — APAC + EU residency questions

Samir — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. High-level responses below; attaching a draft SOW and a data residency addendum for review.

- APAC capacity: we can stage an incremental pool (pilot) in SIN with the following approach: 2x baseline reserved GPUs for pilot (30-day window) then evaluate autoscale to target a 3x steady-state if traffic patterns hold. Estimated monthly delta (pilot): $22k; steady-state (3x): $58k. Exact sizing depends on peak concurrency — Monica can help with a short ingestion of your Q1 usage CSV.

- EU residency + cross-region failover: we can enforce routing by source IP / geo-tagging and keep EU requests pinned to EU pools unless a provider-level outage triggers failover. Failover policy will be explicit in the addendum: failover only on region health checks (two-min sustained failure) and with data-in-transit controls and audit logging. Note: cross-region failover will be logged and replayable; we can add an SLA credit ladder for failover events.

- Prefix caching & autoscale parity: by default we recommend identical cache/kv profiles across region pools to preserve warm-up behavior. If you want per-region cache differentials (e.g., more aggressive prefix caching in SIN), we can configure that as an option.

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica will ingest Q1 usage to produce a sizing recommendation.
2) Ben will review commercial delta and propose a 12-mo renewal amendment with optional 6-mo pilot.
3) I’ll share an updated SOW + residency addendum (attached) and a DocuSign link for signature-ready redlines.

If May 1 is the target, we should lock scope by next Tue (Apr 20). Monica — can you intake the usage CSV and confirm sizing by Mon? Ben — can you surface a redline on pricing by Mon EOD?

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Sr. Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft_SOW_APAC_EP_v2.pdf, Data_Residency_Addendum.docx

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & regional expansion — APAC + EU residency questions

Avery / Ben — I pulled the Q1 export (attached usage_report_Q1.csv) from HealthlyCare’s hosted account and ran a quick headroom calc. Key observations:

- Baseline avg QPS: 48 across business hours (EU window). Peak 95th: 150 QPS.
- Token throughput growth trend: +45% QoQ. If they’re forecasting 2x token growth in APAC, we should size pilot to handle a 1.8x spike to be safe.
- Suggested pilot config (SIN): 2x A10s reserved with autoscale cushion to add 1x during peak. Typical latency impact: +10–20ms 95th.

Commercial implications: pilot incremental ~ $20–25k/mo. Full steady-state (3x reserve across APAC + EU parity) ~ $55–65k/mo depending on committed term. I’ll attach a short slide with the numbers to the SOW link.

On residency specifics: the addendum’s language around "regional pinning" looks good; legal will likely ask for explicit allowed scenarios for failover — I recommend we include a 4-clause failover table (health checks, scheduled maintenance, DDoS + provider outage) and explicit logging retention (90 days by default, optional extension).

I’ll finalize the sizing section in the SOW and mark items that require SOC2 evidence for legal.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage_report_Q1.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthlycare.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Apr 2027 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Final renewal amendment + SOW (pilot + EU residency addendum)

Samir / Olivia — attaching the updated SOW and residency addendum; I’ve also included a one-page summary of the commercial delta. Highlights:

- Pilot (APAC SIN): 2x reserved A10s, autoscale to +1x during peak; pilot term 60 days; pilot delta: $21,500/mo.
- Renewal amendment (12 months): adds APAC region with option to expand to APAC steady-state (3x) at a pre-negotiated uplift. 12-mo committed uplift: $62k/mo.
- Data Residency Addendum: EU pinning guaranteed for at-rest & in-transit for EU-tagged sessions; failover allowed only after two consecutive 120s region health failures or scheduled maintenance; logged and reported with a 90-day audit window. SLA credits for unauthorized cross-region events are defined (tiered: 5%/10%/20%).

What I need from HealthlyCare to proceed:
1) Confirm pilot start date (we propose May 5).
2) Approve the addendum redlines (I’ve set the DocuSign to allow redlines on sections 2 and 5).
3) Confirm whether you want logging retention extended to 365 days (this has a separate cost line shown).

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef-12345
SOW (preview): https://redwood.example.com/drive/HLTH-0422/SOW-v2

Samir — happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the failover table and SLA credit math. If OK, we’ll send the DocuSign this afternoon so legal can start redlining.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Director, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft_SOW_APAC_EP_v2.pdf, Data_Residency_Addendum.docx

On Fri, 22 Apr 2027 09:01:00 -0700, Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthlycare.com> wrote:

> - Can you add a clause that log exports can be pulled into our SIEM within 24 hours of a failover event?
> - Please flag any PII handling during log export.
>
> If you can add those two items I think legal will move quickly.
>
> Samir
